q: The passive form of the sentence 'The boy laughed at the lame man' is—.
o: The lame man was laughed by the boy.
The lame man was laughed at by the boy.
The lame man was being laughed by the boy.
The lame man was being laughed at by the boy.
e:
‘laugh at’ একটি phrasal verb, অর্থাৎ ক্রিয়ার সঙ্গে preposition যুক্ত হয়ে একটি পূর্ণ অর্থ তৈরি করে। Passive করার সময় ক্রিয়ার সঙ্গে থাকা এই preposition বাদ যায় না, তাই ‘at’ ঠিক জায়গায় থেকে যাবে। ফলে সঠিক রূপ হলো The lame man was laughed at by the boy। Simple past tense হওয়ায় ‘was being’ লাগে না।
মনে রাখুন: ‘was being + v₃’ লাগে past continuous tense-এ।
উদাহরণ: They looked after the child → The child was looked after by them.
s: কৃষি সম্প্রসারণ অধিদপ্তর, উপসহকারী কৃষি কর্মকর্তা (২০২১)

q: The correct passive form of the sentence 'Jerina is writing a letter' is-
o: A letter has written by Jerina
A letter has been written by Jerina
A letter was written by Jerina
A letter is being written by Jerina
e: Present continuous বাক্যের passive গঠন: object + am/is/are + being + V3 + by + subject। তাই হয়: A letter is being written by Jerina.
s: বাংলাদেশ সরকারি কর্ম কমিশন, সহকারী পরিচালক (২০০৬)

q: The house is building. The passive form is-
o: A house is being built by us
The masons are building the house
It is the house which is being built
The house is being built
e: The house is building পুরোনো ইংরেজির রীতি, যেখানে V-ing passive অর্থ দিত। আজকের শুদ্ধ রূপ হলো The house is being built। অর্থ: বাড়িটি তৈরি হচ্ছে। প্রথম অপশনে অকারণে কর্তা us যোগ হয়েছে, দ্বিতীয়টি active, আর তৃতীয়টি জোর দেওয়ার গঠন। is being + V3 মনে রাখতে হবে।

q: The passive form of 'You are to color this picture.'' is -
o: This picture has to be colored by you.
This picture is to be color by you.
This picture is to be colored by you.
This picture is being colored by you.
e: be + to + verb গঠনের passive হয় be + to + be + past participle। তাই This picture is to be colored by you.

q: Which one is in passive form of 'Shut the door.
o: The door is shut
The door is shut
The door is shut by me
Let the door be shut

q: His behaviour surprised me. (Passive)
o: I surprised at his behaviour
I was surprised with his behaviour
I had been surprised at his behaviour
I was surprised at his behaviour
e:
Active বাক্যটি past indefinite, তাই passive-এ was + past participle বসবে: I was surprised। Surprise, please, satisfy, interest, shock-এর মতো অনুভূতি বোঝানো verb-এর passive-এ সাধারণত by-এর বদলে নির্দিষ্ট preposition বসে, আর surprised-এর পরে at বসে। তাই সঠিক রূপ: I was surprised at his behaviour.
মনে রাখুন:
pleased with, satisfied with, interested in, known to, filled with।

q: Passive form of 'His conduct annoyed me'-
o: I was annoyed by his conduct.
I am annoyed at his conduct.
I had been annoyed at his conduct.
I was annoyed at his conduct.
e: Active sentence-টি past indefinite, তাই passive-এ 'was + past participle' হবে। 'annoy' verb-এর পরে by-এর বদলে সাধারণত 'at' বা 'with' বসে, তাই 'I was annoyed at his conduct.'

q: The correct passive form of '' I know him '' is -
o: He is known by me.
He was known to me.
He has been known by me.
He is known to me.
e: know verb-এর passive-এ by নয়, to বসে। Present indefinite-এর passive হয় am/is/are + past participle, তাই He is known to me.

q: Select the correct passive voice of "He did for me the unnecessary things."-
o: The unnecessary things were done for me by him.
The unnecessary things was done by him for me.
The unnecessary things had been done for me by him.
The unnecessary things had to be done for me by him.
e: Past indefinite-এর passive: object + was/were + past participle + by + subject। 'Things' plural, তাই were: The unnecessary things were done for me by him.
s: কারিগরি শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, জুনিয়র ইন্সট্রাক্টর (পলিটেকনিক ও টেকনিক্যাল স্কুল) (২০২৩)

q: Change the voice: 'One should read only what one likes.'
o: What one likes should be read only
What one likes should read only
What one likes should have read only
None of the above
e: One কর্তা হলে passive-এ তা বাদ যায়, আর modal should-এর সঙ্গে be + V3 বসে: What one likes should be read only। অর্থ: মানুষের যা ভালো লাগে কেবল তাই পড়া উচিত। দ্বিতীয় অপশনে be নেই, আর তৃতীয়টিতে have read বসায় কাল পাল্টে যায়। অধীন clause 'what one likes' অক্ষত থাকে।

q: The songs of Kazi Nazrul interest me. The correct passive form of the sentence is—
o: I am interested by the songs of Kazi Nazrul.
I am interested with the songs of Kazi Nazrul.
I am interested on the songs of Kazi Nazrul.
I am interested in the songs of Kazi Nazrul.
e:
Interest ক্রিয়াটির active বাক্য ‘The songs interest me’-কে passive করলে ‘I am interested’ হয়। এখানে সাধারণ নিয়মের মতো by না বসে preposition in বসে। তাই সঠিক বাক্য: ‘I am interested in the songs of Kazi Nazrul’। By, with বা on বসালে এই বিশেষ গঠন মেলে না।
মনে রাখুন:
কিছু ক্রিয়ার passive-এ by-এর বদলে অন্য preposition বসে: be surprised at, be pleased with, be known to।
উদাহরণ: This book interests me. → I am interested in this book.

q: I saw him play. (Passive)
o: He was seen by me play.
Play was seen him by me.
He was seen playing by me.
He was seen to play by me.
e:
See, hear, make, let-এর মতো verb-এর পরে Active বাক্যে to ছাড়া Infinitive বসে, যেমন I saw him play। কিন্তু বাক্যটিকে Passive করলে লুকিয়ে থাকা to আবার ফিরে আসে। তাই Passive রূপ: He was seen to play by me.
মনে রাখুন: Active-এ verb-এর ing রূপ থাকলে Passive-এও ing থাকে, যেমন I saw him playing = He was seen playing by me।

q: What is the correct passive form of 'I saw him go to the garden'?
o: He was seen go to the garden
He was seen to go to the garden
He went to the garden was seen
He was been seen to go to the garden
e: See, hear, watch, feel-এর পরে bare infinitive (go) থাকলে active-এ to বসে না, কিন্তু passive-এ সেই infinitive-এর আগে to ফিরে আসে। তাই 'I saw him go' হয় 'He was seen to go to the garden.'। অর্থ: তাকে বাগানে যেতে দেখা গিয়েছিল। 'was seen go' ভুল, কারণ to বাদ পড়েছে; 'was been seen' ভুল, কারণ was-এর সঙ্গে been বসে না। আরেকটি উদাহরণ: 'They heard him sing' থেকে 'He was heard to sing'।

q: Active voice of 'He was being chased by the dogs’
o: The dogs chased him.
The dogs were chasing him.
The dogs are chasing him.
The dogs chase him.
e: 'was being + past participle' হলো past continuous এর passive রূপ। Active করলে হয় 'The dogs were chasing him'।

q: Which is the correct passive form of : We must write to him.
o: He must be written to.
He must be written by us.
He must have written to us.
He must write to us.
e:
Active voice-এর বাক্য We must write to him-এ write to একটি যুক্তক্রিয়া, যার preposition ‘to’ passive-এ পরিবর্তিত হয় না। কর্ম ‘him’ কর্তা হয়ে ‘He’ হয়। Modal verb must থাকলে passive-এ must be + past participle বসে। তাই বাক্যটি হয় He must be written to (by us)। অন্য অপশনগুলোতে ‘to’ বাদ পড়েছে, কিংবা বাক্যটি active-ই রয়ে গেছে, তাই অর্থ ঠিক থাকে না।
মনে রাখুন: Modal verb-এর passive গঠন: Subject + modal + be + V3।

q: 'Please close the door.' The passive form of this sentence is:
o: Let the door be closed.
You are requested to close the door.
The door is to be closed.
I request you to close the door.
e: Please বা kindly যুক্ত অনুরোধের বাক্য passive করতে 'You are requested to ...' কাঠামো ব্যবহার হয়। তাই 'Please close the door' এর passive 'You are requested to close the door.'। অর্থ: দয়া করে দরজাটি বন্ধ করুন। 'Let the door be closed' সাধারণ আদেশের (command) passive, আর 'I request you to ...' এখনও active। সাধারণ আদেশে Let + object + be + V3 বসে, কিন্তু অনুরোধে requested ব্যবহার হয়।

q: The best passive form of the sentence 'Most people saw him as a sort of clown.' is :
o: He had been seen as a sort of clown.
They had seen him as a sort of clown.
He was seen as a sort of clown.
He has been seen as a sort of clown
He has mostly been seen as a clown.
e: মূল বাক্য simple past, তাই passive হবে 'was + past participle'। object him হয়ে যায় subject He, তাই 'He was seen as a sort of clown'।

q: 'The work is done by Medha.' This is an example of ___.
o: active voice
passive voice
quasi-passive voice
not any voice which are mentioned
e: 'is + past participle + by + কর্তা' গঠনটি passive voice চেনায়। এখানে work কাজটির বস্তু, আর by Medha কর্তা বোঝাচ্ছে। বাক্যের অর্থ: কাজটি মেধার দ্বারা সম্পন্ন হয়েছে। Active রূপ হবে 'Medha does the work'। Quasi-passive বলে এমন বাক্যকে যেখানে গঠনে active হলেও অর্থে passive থাকে, যেমন 'The book sells well'। এখানে স্পষ্ট by-যুক্ত passive।

q: Passive voice of "None likes him" is--
o: He was not liked by anyone.
He is liked by none.
He has not been liked by anyone.
He is no liked by anyone.

q: 'Who will do the work' -এর সঠিক passive form:
o: Who will be done the work?
Work will be done by whom?
Who has to be done the work?
By whom will the work be done?
e: 'Who' দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্নের passive-এ 'By whom' দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হয় এবং প্রশ্নবোধক গঠন বজায় থাকে। তাই 'By whom will the work be done?'
